title: security: RBAC v2 policies + audit enrichment + KMS region pinning controls
author: Priya Shah
description: Add RBAC v2 policy schema and enforcement hooks, enrich audit logs with KMS key metadata and region pinning controls for data residency. Motivation: customers in regulated industries require fine-grained role policies (RBAC v2) and auditable proof of key usage and region enforcement when routing requests to Dedicated/Private deployments. This PR introduces: 1) a backward-compatible RBAC v2 policy schema and generator with migration helpers; 2) enforcement middleware in authz service and BFF to evaluate RBAC v2 during token introspection and route-level authorization; 3) audit enrichment that records KMS key id/arn, key wrapping method, and region when encrypting/decrypting model inputs/outputs; 4) region pinning policy at routing layer with declarative per-tenant rules and automatic fallback; 5) end-to-end tests and e2e staging manifest changes. Checklist: [x] RBAC v2 schema + generator; [x] enforcement hooks in authz service; [x] audit enrichment and KMS metadata capture; [x] region pinning routing policy; [x] unit + integration tests; [x] migration script and data-backfill plan; [ ] docs: follow-up (docs/SEC-notes). Link: Linear ENG-4521, SEC-328, INF-213. This description includes migration notes: the migration script writes a mapping table (tenants.rbac_v1_to_v2) and a non-blocking backfill that will run over the next 7 days post-deploy. Rollout plan: deploy enforcement as opt-in by default for 24 hours, enable for pilot tenants, then flip global enforcement after monitoring and regression checks. Impact: non-breaking for most customers, but new stricter checks can block misconfigured service accounts until RBAC v2 mappings are applied.

discussion: Samir Patel: Can you clarify the migration strategy? I want to ensure we have a non-blocking path for existing service accounts.

Priya Shah: Migration is non-blocking by default. We write tenants.rbac_v1_to_v2 mapping and the authz middleware falls back to v1 semantics when mapping is missing. The migration CLI can dry-run mappings and create suggested v2 policies.
Lucia Gomez: Audit logs now include kms_key_region — are we adding any PII? We should avoid raw ARNs if they contain account IDs.
Priya Shah: We record key id (short form) and region only; we obfuscate account IDs in ARNs by default. The enricher has a REDACT_ACCOUNT_IDS flag for additional privacy.
Ethan Park: Tests look good. CI failed initially on race detection in authz middleware; I re-ran the job and it passed. Please add a note about the race in the middleware comments.
Priya Shah: Added a FIXME with reference to INF-213 and a follow-up task to rework the lock-free cache in a separate PR.
Maya Thompson: Approve with comments — please ensure chart values for helm are validated in the installer pipeline before release.
